tools.name: search_sets
tools.description: Search public LEGO listings by name or set number, with optional category, theme, condition and USD price filters. Returns paginated items with title, set number, condition, price, availability and product URL.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Return one public listing's current status (available, sold or Available Soon), USD price and product URL, by item UUID or slug. Uncached.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Return the shipping quote for one public listing and a two-letter country code. US ground shipping is included ($0 extra); other countries are unsupported. Does not reserve or buy.

tools.name: read_policies
tools.description: Return the shop's published shipping, returns, sales-tax and Verified Complete checking policies as text.
